title: The Blackwood Shed
description: You awake bound in a storm-battered wooden shed alongside two fellow researchers. An unpredictable sentry and an armed captor guard the exit. Survive through psychological observation, empathy, trust, and tactical negotiation.

characters.name: Corwin
characters.title: Fellow Anthropologist / Research Partner
characters.goal: Survive the night, calm panic attacks, analyze bindings, escape without bloodshed.
characters.fear: Being abandoned, physical violence, aggressive shouts.

characters.name: Wren
characters.title: Fellow Captive / Forest Researcher
characters.goal: Recover from berry toxicity, maintain hope, assist in untying knots.
characters.fear: Succumbing to poison, cold cruelty from captors.

characters.name: Sable
characters.title: The Sharp Smiling Captor
characters.goal: Identify valuable knowledge or trades while toying with prisoners.
characters.fear: Being made a fool, boring compliance.

characters.name: Garrow
characters.title: The Heavy Guard / Enforcer
characters.goal: Maintain strict authority and obey his elders while evaluating prisoner honor.
